THE COMMISSION HAS ANNOUNCED THAT IT HAS ACCEPTED AN OFFER OF SETTLEMENT FROM CHRISTOPH SECURITIES, INC. A BROKER DEALER LOCATED IN LAKE FOREST, IL, AND RICHARD T. CHRISTOPH, PRESIDENT AND SOLE SHAREHOLDER.  THE RESPONDANTS CONSENTED TO FINDINGS THAT THEY WERE ENJOINED FROM VIOLATING OR AIDING AND ABETTING VIOLATIONS OF SECTION 10(B) AND 15C1-2 OF THE EXCHANGE ACT AND RULES 10B-3, 10B-5, AND 15C1-2 THEREUNDER AND CHRISTOPH CONSENTED TO FINDINGS THAT HE WAS ENJOINED FROM VIOLATING SECTION 7(F) OF THE EXCHANGE ACT AND REGULATION X THEREUNDER AND FROM AIDING AND ABETTING VIOLATIONS OF SECTION 7(D) OF THE EXCAHNGE ACT AND REGULATION U THEREUNDER. IN ITS OFFER OF SETTLEMENT, CHRISTOPH SECURITIES CONSENTED TO SUSPENSION OF ITS REGISTRATIONAS A BROKER-DEALER FOR 45 DAYS AND CHRISTOPH'S OFFER OF SETTLEMENT INCLUDED HIS CONSENT TO A SUSPENSION FROM ASSSOCIATION IN ANY CAPACITY WITH ANY BROKER-DEALER FOR A PERIOD OF 45 DAYS."]}}, {"eventDate": "4/12/1982", "disclosureType": "Civil", "disclosureResolution": "Final", "isIapdExcludedCCFlag": "N", "isBcExcludedCCFlag": "N", "bcCtgryType": 20, "disclosureDetail": {"Initiated By": "SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION", "Resolution": "Consent", "SanctionDetails": [{"Sanctions": "Disgorgement/Restitution"}, {"Sanctions": "Cease and Desist/Injunction"}], "Broker Comment": ["SEC NEWS DIGEST, APRIL 13, 1982, ISSUE 82-70.  ON APRIL 12, 1982 THE U.S. DISTRICT COURT FOR THE NORTHERN DISTRICT OF ILLINOIS, EASTERN DIVISION, ENTERED A FINAL JUDGEMENT OF PERMANENT INJUNCTION AGAINST CHRISTOPH SECURITIES, INC. AND RICHARD T. CHRISTOPH, BOTH LOCATED IN LAKE FOREST, IL.  THE DEFENDANTS BOTH CONSENTED TO THE INJUNCTIONS WITHOUT ADMITTING OR DENYING THE ALLEGATIONS IN THE COMMISSION'S COMPLAINT.  THE JUDGEMENT ENJOINS THE RESPONDENTS FROM VIOLATING OR AIDING AND ABETTING VIOLATIONS OF SECTION 10(B) ABD 15(C)(1) OF THE SEC ACT OF 1934 AND RULES 10B-3, 10B-5, AND 15C1-2 THEREUNDER.  IN ADDITION THE JUDGEMENT ENJOINS CHRISTOPH FROM AIDING AND ABETTING VIOLATIONS OF CREDIT PROVISIONS OF THE EXCHANGE ACT.  THE COMPLAINT ALLEGED THAT THE DEFENDANTS PURCHASED GREAT SOUTHERN CORPORATION STOCK DURING THE PERIOD OF MAY 9, 1978 TO JUNE 26, 1978 WHILE IN POSSESION OF MATERIAL, NON PUBLIC INFORMATION CONCERNING THE INTEREST OF NLT CORPORATION IN ACQUIRING GREAT SOUTHERN AND THE ACQUISITION OF NLT BY GREAT SOUTHERN STOCK.  IT WAS ALSO ALLEGED THAT BETWEEN JANUARY 25, 1978 AND MAY 8, 1978 THE DEFENDANTS FAILED TO DISCLOSE MATERIAL FACTS IN THE CONNECTION OF SALE OF GREAT SOUTHERN STOCK.  THE JUDGEMENT ALSO ORDERS THE DISGORGEMENT OF PROFIT OF $200,000 ARISING FROM THE PURCHASE OF GREAT SOUTHERN STOCK. (SEC V. CHRISTOPH SECURITIES, ET AL., N.D. ILL., CIVIL ACTION NO. 82-C-2216).
